_about: EVERYTHING AT ONCE: every field the format has, in one style that works.
TARGETING: an exact biome AND a tag, minus two excludes. 'star' makes it beat an unstarred style that names
the same biome. 'enabled' false would turn the whole style off. cohesion 0.8 keeps the skin tight to the water.
RINGS, water outward: bed (under the water) -> waterline (the wet/dry band) -> bank -> top_bank -> 'rings'.
Every size is a percent of the stream's width, and the reaches ADD UP: 45 + 25 + 20 + 10 fills the whole cut.
OVERRIDES use all eight stream properties: slope, width, speed, bend with side, to_mouth, to_junction, flat_run.
Each is 0..1. fade softens the switch (0 = a hard line, 0.2 = a wide dither). First one that holds paints.
PATTERNS: blobs = patches, bands = stripes along the stream, speckle = the old block-by-block mix.
SCENERY: bed plants under the water, waterline at the surface, bank and top_bank on dry land. Copy the four
definitions it names out of bank_features/examples/ into bank_features/, or those rings plant nothing.
